title: Ylham tarapyndan täzeden ýazylan girew
intro: Özüňizi örän möhüm birine ynanylan, soňra bolsa gulak asmak üçin gatnaşygy kesýän buýruk bilen ýüzbe-ýüz bolýanyňyzy göz öňüne getiriň. Wahy tutuş maşgalany täzeden kemala getirdi we buýruk merkezindäki at hiç haçan ýüzlenilýän adam bolmady.
clues: Men şahsy wepalylygyň Hudaýyň itaatyna boýun egmeli ýerinde durdum.
Men Resulyň öýünde ogullyga alnan ogul hökmünde tanalýardym.
Men nikamyň Allahyň Resulyna iberilen wahyýyň temasy bolandygyny bildim.
Maňa gönükdirilen: "Aýalyňy sakla we Alladan gork" diýen sözleri eşitdim.
Soňra men Allanyň Resulyna käbir aýallary talak etmegi buýrandygyny we meniň öz nikamyň şol buýruk bilen gutarmalydygyny bildim.
Men Zaýd ibn Haritha, Al-Ahzb süresinde ogullyga alnan ogul.

trial.label: Synag/Waka
options: Aýalyny saklamagy aýdylyp, soňra ondan aýrylyşmagy tabşyrylýar
trial.answer: Aýalyny saklamagy aýdylyp, soňra ondan aýrylyşmagy tabşyrylýar

outcome.label: Netije
options: Buýruga boýun boldy, aýaly bilen aýrylyşdy we nikasy bozuldy
Uly balyk tarapyndan ýuwudylandan soň halas edildi
Gündogarda we Günbatarda höküm sürmek hukugy berildi
outcome.answer: Buýruga boýun boldy, aýaly bilen aýrylyşdy we nikasy bozuldy

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
